# crosswork_assign_devices_to_data_gateway (Resource)

This resource attaches devices to a data gateway.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_assign_devices_to_data_gateway" "example" {
  data_gateway_id = "8551f8dc-91eb-43ee-ad4f-6e1993ca524c"
  devices         = ["build-router-1"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `data_gateway_id` (String) Id of the data gateway, as `data_gateway_ids` of `crosswork_data_gateway_pools` lists it
- `devices` (Set of String) Inventory ids of the devices that are attached to the data gateway; an empty list detaches them all

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_assign_devices_to_data_gateway.example "<data_gateway_id>"
```
